# The actual skygo client strictly decodes each emitted task file and sends
# exactly the lowered task. The recording server prints what it received as
# protobuf JSON, in which int64 values are decimal strings.

fakeserver

skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref $IMPORT/workdir-ref.json --output out --target local --allow-drop name $IMPORT/local/task.yaml
cp stdout local.json
skygo plan -f local.json
stdout '\Alocal\n\z'
received
cmp stdout local.received

skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref $IMPORT/workdir-ref.json --output out --allow-drop name $IMPORT/kubernetes/task.yaml
cp stdout kubernetes.json
skygo plan -f kubernetes.json
received
cmp stdout kubernetes.received

skycompat import --shell /bin/bash --target gpu --timeout-seconds 3600 $IMPORT/accept/resources.yaml
cp stdout resources.json
skygo plan -f resources.json
received
cmp stdout resources.received

skycompat import --shell /bin/sh $IMPORT/accept/multiline.yaml
cp stdout multiline.json
skygo plan -f multiline.json
received
cmp stdout multiline.received

skycompat import --shell /bin/sh exotic.yaml
cp stdout exotic.json
skygo plan -f exotic.json
received
cmp stdout exotic.received

# The FROZEN-1 literal form of the same case: raw U+2028 and U+FEFF inside
# the quoted scalar. Expected bytes are UNRUN, derived from yaml.v3 v3.0.1
# source: a raw U+2028 is a line break that a double-quoted scalar keeps
# verbatim (only a leading LF folds to a space), and a raw U+FEFF is an
# ordinary character. The actual decode is asserted by cmp.
skycompat import --shell /bin/sh exotic-literal.yaml
cp stdout exotic-literal.json
skygo plan -f exotic-literal.json
received
cmp stdout exotic-literal.received

skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --timeout-seconds 604800 large.yaml
cp stdout large.json
skygo plan -f large.json
received
cmp stdout large.received

# A key this skygo does not know fails strict decoding before any call, as
# an older skygo would for a newer importer's key.
! skygo plan -f unknown-key.json
stderr 'field unknown_task_field not found'
received
! stdout .

# A workspace task against an endpoint without the artifact snapshot
# service is refused after discovery and before any submission.
! skygo run -f local.json --wait --request-id import-1
stderr 'endpoint does not advertise artifact-snapshot-service-v1'
received
cmp stdout run.received

-- exotic.yaml --
run: "a\u2028b\x85c\ufeffd\x7fe\x01f\x1bg\th — ✓ 🚀"
-- large.yaml --
run: x
resources:
  cpus: 1000000000000000
  memory: 8191PB
  accelerators: {A: 2147483647}
